lines.en: I creep out from under the flowers.
Roots for feet, I take one step at a time.
Petals fall where I pass.
Vines wrap around me.

lines.zh: 我的身体是绿的，藏在叶子里。
lines.en: Green body, hidden in the leaves.
I slink along the shrub line.
Each step lands on fallen leaves.
I drag a dead branch.
I go around the thickest flowers.
My leaves rustle in the wind.
I part a clump of ferns.
I pull a foot out of the soil.
Standing still as a shrub.
A small flower blooms on me.
The woods go quiet, and only then do I speak.
My fingers are twigs.
A butterfly lands on my shoulder.
I sink my roots deeper.

lines.zh: 我在数今天落了几朵花。
lines.en: I count the flowers that fell today.
Water in the soil climbs upward.
I keep still so the flowers dare to open.
My leaves turn toward the sun.
An insect crawls over my arm.
I spread my branch-hands, then close them.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸是叶子的味道。
lines.en: My breath smells of leaves.
I knocked off a blossom.
I wait for rain.
No one comes to this wood.
I sink and I grow.
Such patience I have.
You crushed a flower.
I smell broken stems.
These flowers are mine to guard.
There are petals on your boot.

lines.zh: 我把脸从叶子里转出来。
lines.en: I turn my face out of the leaves.
You should not have touched that one.
I am covered in thorns.
Stand still for now.
I grew out of the soil.
How many do you mean to pick?

lines.zh: 我在这片花床边站了几十年。
lines.en: I've stood by this flower bed for decades.
Step back. You are on my roots.
My leaves have fallen.
A branch of mine has snapped.
Water seeps into the soil.
I lost a leaf.
It hurts like a cut.
I lost a flower.
I brace on my own trunk and stand straight.
My roots hold. I do not fall.
This will grow back.
Do not break any more flowers.
Give me that flower.
The stem in your hand is still alive.
Put it down. Do not pick it.
I prefer what comes from the soil.
That pot of soil is rich.
One has already wilted.
I will plant it back.
Do not squeeze it so hard.
The root is intact. It can live.
Give me a handful of soil too.
Your heel is on my roots.
I cannot retreat. My roots are deep.
Do not push. I would break.
You knocked off some leaves.
There are vines between us.
You knocked off a flower.
That bump does not move me.
Steady. I stand in mud.
Do not pull at my branch.
Go around me.
I am a plant.
Flowers bloom and fall. Not my concern.
For seeds, you must wait.
Few of my kind in this wood.

lines.zh: 你折了我的花，还想问这个。
lines.en: You broke my flowers and ask that?
I am rooted here.
This topic makes my leaves drop.
I only split into new shoots.
Speak when the flowers fade.
Do not tug my vines.
This one fell. I carry it back to the soil.
I press it back into the soil.
The root survives. It can be replanted.
This leaf is still green.
I cup the soil in my twig fingers.
It has dried out completely.
I stick it back into the bed.
This soil is useful.
Bury it, add a little water.
Do not step here.
You touched that flower.
I heard a stem snap.
I have risen out of the soil.
You crushed my roots.
I remember the flower you crushed.
The vines have started to move.
New thorns grow on me.

lines.zh: 这里的花，一朵都不能少。
lines.en: Not one of these flowers may be lost.
I am counting what you crushed.

lines.zh: 藤已经绕到你脚踝上了。
lines.en: The vine's already around your ankle.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，踩着自己的叶。
lines.en: Step by step, I walk over my own leaves.
Flowers everywhere. I step carefully.
You are backed against the flower bed.
A vine has found your ankle.
The roots crawl forward slowly.
My leaves are moving.
You are standing on my roots.
This branch has grown just right.
I am counting the flowers.
One more step and you're on the flowers.
A branch whips your back.
The vines pull tight.
A flat strike sends you stumbling sideways.
A thorn opens your sleeve.
That blow came with soil.
Your legs are bound.
I yank backward hard.
Our struggle crushed the flowers.
These hands of mine are hard as wood.
One more loop.
I grow up out of the flowers.
The soil has been pushed apart.
Dew still on my leaves.
The flowers turn toward me.
First I extend one branch.
Someone has broken flowers here.
The soil cracks open, and I straighten up.
Soil falls from my shoulder.
This bed of flowers is mine.
My roots have spread below.
I smell snapped stems.
I push up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 火过处，我的叶子卷成条。
lines.en: Where the fire passed, my leaves curled tight.

lines.zh: 我倒下时压坏了自己的花。
lines.en: Falling, I crushed my own flowers.
The soil has been soaked to muck.
The blast turns the soil over.
An arrow sticks in my trunk.
This light yellows my leaves.
The soil's gone dry. My roots find nothing.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的枝条焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my branch is scorched.
No soil. My roots find nothing.
